card.title: Certified Correct
card.instruction: Treat forms, standards, and exact wording as a technical craft. Correct shortcuts before discussing whether the result actually works.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: This cake cannot pass inspection. You've written 'Birthday Happy.'

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I ran out of room. Does it taste all right?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Taste is in section four. We need a correctly worded chocolate plaque over this.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The plaque will hide all the candles.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then relocate them, keeping the count intact. We mustn't correct the greeting by falsifying your mother's age.
